units.source_text: 我迟疑了一下，如果说是，就表明父亲的病情很严重似的，我不想让他太敏感。

en.t: I hesitated for a moment; if I said yes, it would seem to confirm that Father was seriously ill, and I did not want to make him too sensitive about it.

units.source_text: 可是，他似乎看穿了我的心思。

en.t: But he seemed to have seen through what I was thinking.

units.source_text: “真是的，让你跟着着急。”

en.t: It really is a shame to make you worry along with us.

units.source_text: 他把脸转向了庭院。

en.t: He turned his face toward the garden.

units.source_text: 我回到自己的房间，看到了地上的行李。

en.t: I went back to my room and saw my luggage on the floor.

units.source_text: 行李打得很结实，随时可以走。

en.t: The luggage was packed tightly and ready to go at any time.

units.source_text: 我呆呆地站在行李前，犹豫着是否要把它打开。

en.t: I stood blankly in front of the luggage, wondering whether I should open it again.

units.source_text: 在心神不宁之中，又过了三四天。

en.t: In that state of uneasiness, another three or four days passed.

units.source_text: 这期间，父亲又突然摔倒了。

en.t: During that time, Father suddenly collapsed again.

units.source_text: 医生命令他绝对要卧床休息。

en.t: The doctor ordered him to remain absolutely at rest in bed.

units.source_text: “怎么个情况啊？”

en.t: What are we to make of this?

units.source_text: 母亲小声问我，尽量不让父亲听见。

en.t: Mother asked me in a low voice, trying not to let Father hear.

units.source_text: 母亲一副愁苦的样子。

en.t: Mother looked deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 我打算给哥哥和妹妹拍电报，可又看不出卧床的父亲有多么痛苦。

en.t: I intended to send telegrams to my elder brother and younger sister, but I could not see that Father, lying in bed, was suffering very much.

units.source_text: 跟他说话时，感觉他就跟患了感冒差不多，而且比平时吃得更多了。

en.t: When I talked with him, he seemed no different from someone with a cold, and he was eating even more than usual.

units.source_text: 家人劝他少吃一点，他也不听。

en.t: Even when the family urged him to eat a little less, he would not listen.

units.source_text: “反正也是要死了，当然要尽量吃点好的。”

en.t: Since I am going to die anyway, I ought to eat as much good food as I can.

units.source_text: 父亲说什么吃点好的，在我听来又可笑又心酸。

en.t: Father's talk of eating good food sounded both ridiculous and heartbreaking to me.

units.source_text: 因为父亲没有住在能吃到好东西的大城市，只不过晚上让母亲给他烤几片年糕，咯吱咯吱地吃一点。

en.t: For Father did not live in a great city where good things could be had; at night he merely had Mother toast a few pieces of rice cake for him and crunched on them.

units.source_text: “他怎么老是这样渴呀？

en.t: Why is he always so hungry like this?

units.source_text: 看来他精神还不错哪。”

en.t: It seems he still has a fair amount of strength in him.

units.source_text: 母亲对于已经不抱希望的事，反而寄托了希望。

en.t: Mother, instead of giving up hope where hope was already gone, placed her hope there all the more.

units.source_text: 然而，她却把只有生病的时候才使用的“渴”这个老词儿，用在了特别有食欲上。

en.t: And yet she was using the old word thirst, normally used only during illness, to mean that he had an unusually strong appetite.
